source: corrected August labels and causal daily panels
condition: option spread volume weighted prior 60 rank >= 0.80
matched_controls: non-trigger observations same date, ATR14Pct bin <=2, (2,5], (5,10], >10, and stock prior-only within-symbol 60-day volume rank <=.33, (.33,.66], (.66,1]; exclude unmatched signals. Absolute volume units not assumed validated
bootstrap: 2000 circular 5-date block resamples of cross-sectional day-mean differences; descriptive, NOT post-selection confidence
extra_quote_lag: D0 uses the immediately previous XNYS session option-rank (D-1), not an arbitrarily old quote; same D0 underlying label, no forward fill
exclusions: top five determined separately per split using inspected returns and solely an influence diagnostic; NEVER a tradable rule
